items.name: hook_hi
items.direction: Narrate this in natural spoken Hindi, the way a popular Indian geography explainer YouTube Shorts channel talks. Numbers and English words are read in English. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy. The opening is a bold dare to the viewer: punchy, confident, a beat of wonder on 'उल्टी', a short beat before 'तो कैसे?'.
lines: ये असली one point seven tonne की car है। ये एक truck के ऊपर से उड़ी और उल्टी लटक गई।
